crossRefs.note: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and…

translations.web: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
translations.bsb: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters.
translations.kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
translations.asv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, So is a faithful messenger to them that send him; For he refresheth the soul of his masters.
